Myrnath is a victim of the mind flayers during the Prologue. His body hosts an intellect devourer named  Us.

Involvement

Prologue

Myrnath is aboard the Nautiloid and is on an upper ledge next to a collection of brain jars, mind sanctuaries, and tentacle aquariums. Upon entering the room he is in, Myrnath seemingly calls out to the player character, asking them to "help us". If approached, it is quickly revealed that a psionic presence – rather than Myrnath – is communicating with the player character via telepathy. Investigating further reveals that Myrnath's skull has been partially removed. His exposed quivering brain is a newborn intellect devourer.

Myrnath cannot be saved or spoken with. If Us is freed or killed, Myrnath dies; if Myrnath dies before Us is freed, Us dies as well.
